bounds.scope: One owner, one exact predecessor and at most one current successor; explicit retry after cancellation or preparation failure; permanent configuration and identity loss; known and unknown consent and retirement outcomes.
bounds.progress: Safety only. Provider or network completion is not assumed fair; failed retirement can remain blocked indefinitely.
bounds.limitations: Abstract source-linked model, not automatic TypeScript refinement. No live provider, latency, fleet, storage durability or cryptographic proof. Unknown consent cannot mint; its server ledger expires under the existing contract. Existing local transport and authenticated-host tests cover concrete admission ordering.
